author: Apple
description:
MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display is the most advanced MacBook Pro. Featuring a tandem OLED display with unparalleled brightness, contrast, and color. For the first time on Mac, touch capabilities let you scroll, pinch, and rotate directly onscreen. The M5 Pro or M5 Max chip delivers superfast performance and advanced AI capabilities. MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display also features up to 24 hours of battery life, the best audio system in a laptop, and a lighter design than the previous MacBook Pro.

Pre-order MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display. Available starting 11.6.

Learn more: https://apple.co/47NHao7

Battery life varies by use and configuration.

author: Apple
description:
Introducing the new MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display. The first MacBook Pro with Touch, it features a stunning tandem OLED display. With such vivid colors, exceptional brightness, and razor-sharp contrast, you’ll want to reach out and touch it.

And now, you can. Tap, swipe, scroll, and pinch to zoom directly on your screen, while all your favorite keyboard shortcuts and trackpad gestures stay close at hand.

The M5 Pro or M5 Max chip powers it all, for pro-level performance and advanced AI capabilities, plus up to 24 hours of battery life. And with up to 16TB SSD storage and up to 128GB unified memory, it’s a serious upgrade to your workflow.

Pre-order MacBook Pro with PROLED XDR Display. Available starting 11.6.

Learn more: https://apple.co/4i8yDSO
